dispute.statement: I asked to stop at Paya Lebar Square and we did, fine, but the fare was much more than the estimate. I think the detour was overcharged.

chat.text: Can you stop at Paya Lebar Square? I need to grab a parcel, 3-4 minutes.

driver_statement: The rider asked me to stop at Paya Lebar Square, so I drove there and waited while the rider went in.
